title: V2 rocket goes off course into Mexico as a warning
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of V2 rocket goes off course into Mexico as a warning, about late 1940s at Mexico (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Next thing you know, a V2 rocket goes off course and hits a a place in Mexico.

plain: Jason Jorjani, a researcher who writes about Nazi Germany's alleged UFO work, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that in the late 1940s a V2, the long-range rocket Germany built in the Second World War, went off course and struck a place in Mexico. In his telling it was not an accident but a warning. If true, it would hint that someone outside American control still held German rocket power after the war.
